31:20.text: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors,
apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book

31:21.text: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?

31:22.text: to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of

31:23.text: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

31:24.text: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

31:25.text: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "
to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.

31:26.text: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

31:27.text: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea
of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

31:28.text: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul.
Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
